description: Local DeviceSpec bundle used by frontend/public/test/scene1 before uploading specs to the backend database.
notes: These files are local copies of the current SimulationSchema DeviceSpecs plus scene1 execution-contract additions.
Physical interfaces are model/device connection anchors; material movement is represented by process_ports and SceneDocument runtime_geometry.
The conveyor spec contains reusable device-local process path geometry; scene-specific transport paths live on SceneDocument instances.
Robot pick/place process points and runtime IK chain snapshots are compiled into SceneDocument.instances[].runtime_geometry/runtime_kinematics for playback.
Upload these specs before importing scene_document.json so every spec_id can resolve.
